The '''Obohn Gallery of the Industrial Aesthetic''' was a collection of art, specializing in works of a metallic style. It had at least two curators, [[Dremullar Obohn di Garthos]] and "[[Father (Rodian)|Father]]." [[Marn Hierogryph]] and [[Zayne Carrick]] attempted to sell homemade scrap statuary to the gallery, claiming it to be the work of [[Ineas Tikartine]]. The pieces were refused at first, but Zayne used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to secure their purchase.<ref name="lp">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/fiction/f20080409/index.html|text="Labor Pains"|int=Labor Pains|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>
